body:
I have some information regarding cocaine drug testing.
I used on a friday, last dose around 2:45 PM. First dose around 1:45, used a $20 of crack. I took an at home test at 5:00 PM on MONDAY, BUT I did exercise copiously, drank a bottle of cranberry juice (the big ones) Monday morning, and drank lots of water on sunday evening. So after about 72 hours, I tested clean. I hope this information helps you guys. Just for knowledge, I exercised saturday, sunday, AND monday. Im talking relatively heavy exercise too. Good luck to anyone who finds this information useful.
